items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: We had Edwin Mayer... Bill Senegal... But then they had back, his name, the drummer was named Sam Noel.

ctx.x: So who was in the band when you were there, when you were in the band?
We had Edwin Mayer, who was a guitar player. Bill Senegal, who played bass and tenor saxophone sometimes. But then they had back, his name, the drummer was named Sam Noel.
